name: RunWay token lets anyone burn inflated sell volume from its pair
summary: RunWay (BYC) adds each sell's amount to lpBurnFrequency, and its public autoBurnLiquidity() burns that many BYC straight from the BYC/USDT pair and syncs. Backrunning launch(), the attacker flash-borrowed USDT, cycled BYC through the pair to inflate lpBurnFrequency, burned the pair's BYC reserve and sold BYC into the depleted reserve for the pair's USDT.
notes: The owner's launch() one transaction earlier only set startTradeBlock, a trading gate: the burn logic and the public autoBurnLiquidity() were in the code from deployment, so the deployment is the reset (rule 10). setPoolAddress shortly after deployment only names the recipient of buy mints.

Loss is the USDT depletion of the BYC/USDT pair, which fell to dust, plus a copycat's drain of the team's relaunched BYC token (same code, pair 0x3517df15…) a day later. USDT the token kept from fee swaps is protocol custody and is not netted. No other exercise in either pair's USDT history.
